overall: The AG found the Chair's two emails to a quorum were improper deliberation, an individual violation since no member responded, and ordered the emails released at the next meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee Chair emailed a quorum of the Committee about matters within its jurisdiction, outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: While we find that these emails constituted improper deliberation outside of an open meeting, because no Committee members responded to either message we find this was an individual violation of the law.

allegations.summary: Complainant was dissatisfied with the Chair's written apology for the violation and asked the AG to review whether it was sufficient.
allegations.key_passage: While our office encourages public bodies to offer apologies where appropriate, we generally will not take a position on whether the manner or content of the apology was sufficient.

remedy: Release to the public the two emails identified in the letter at the Committee's next meeting.
remedy_passage: In order to fully address the violation that occurred, we order the Committee to release to the public the two emails identified in this letter at its next meeting.
